questions.stem: Of 12 binary strings, 7 start with 0, 8 end with 1 and 5 do both. How many do neither?
questions.explain: At least one property holds for 7 + 8 − 5 = 10 strings, so 12 − 10 = 2 have neither.
It is an arithmetic series with 10 terms, so the sum is 10/2 × (3 + 39) = 5 × 42 = 210.
This geometric series has ratio 2 and 10 terms, so the sum is 2¹⁰ − 1 = 1023.

questions.stem: Find the sum of the infinite series $1+\frac13+\frac19+\frac1{27}+\cdots$
questions.explain: An infinite geometric series with ratio 1/3 sums to first term ÷ (1 − ratio) = 1 ÷ (2/3) = 3/2 = 1.5.

questions.stem: How many binary strings of length 4 have exactly two 1s?
questions.explain: Choose which 2 of the 4 positions hold the 1s: 4C2 = 6.
